title: Rainy Day Product Board

needsDecision.title: Host menu cards still list a syrup's parts
needsDecision.meta: Greg said the card should show only the syrup's name, for example honey syrup. A fix has not been approved yet.

needsDecision.title: A metric copy of a syrup with different amounts only partly comes off
Fix already-saved drinks that still use the old syrup layout
needsDecision.meta: New scans will be right. Changing drinks already saved would be a live data change, which needs Greg's OK.

inProgress.title: Tester upload to TestFlight and Play
inProgress.meta: Greg approved this morning for testers only. The Builder is uploading now; the stores have not confirmed it yet. This build has the drink-amount fixes and the syrup photo fix. No public release.

inProgress.title: Android catch-up to iPhone
inProgress.meta: Greg wants Android to match iPhone. A tester upload is in progress now with the drink-amount fixes and the syrup heading fix for recipes you type or paste (Android has no photo-scan path). Style-line fixes and a few other iPhone changes still need to be copied over.

inProgress.title: Six small edit-screen edge cases (iPhone)
inProgress.meta: Greg chose to ship now and fix these in the next build.

onHold.title: Single AI reader
onHold.meta: Approved, but parked until the syrup feature ships. The spend cap is part of this.

onHold.title: Check menu sharing on an Android phone
Website and marketing
onHold.meta: Includes screenshots and selling focus. The latest cut of the Guests at Eight video ad was emailed to Sas; it has not been posted or run.

onHold.title: Should shared drinks open only by link?
onHold.meta: Today someone who knows how can list all shared drinks at once. Nothing is broken; this is a decision for later.

doneThisWeek.title: Drink-amount fix passed review on both apps
doneThisWeek.meta: Blood and Sand is equal parts. Cherry liqueur is back to 1/2 oz. A Luxardo cherry is a garnish again. This is in the build being uploaded for testers.

doneThisWeek.title: Photo-upload syrup fix passed review
doneThisWeek.meta: Scanned recipes now split a syrup into Rachael's format, and section headings no longer get 0.5 oz. This is in the build being uploaded for testers. Android has no photo-scan path; typed or pasted recipes get the heading fix.

doneThisWeek.title: iPhone TestFlight build 6 is uploaded for testers
doneThisWeek.meta: Version 3.0.1 (6). Includes the host menu changes and the beer style fix (a beer's style always shows in the list). Testers only: no public release.

doneThisWeek.title: Greg chose to ship the beer style fix as-is

doneThisWeek.title: Scotch or Whisky label follows the user's own categories
doneThisWeek.meta: Greg decided this; iPhone and Android should match.

doneThisWeek.title: Bee's Knees main listing now uses honey syrup
doneThisWeek.meta: Confirmed live: 2 oz gin, 0.75 oz fresh lemon juice, 0.75 oz honey syrup.

doneThisWeek.title: Rachael's syrup feature and the host menu maker are in iPhone TestFlight for testers
doneThisWeek.meta: The syrup shows as one line; its parts stay out of the drink list; the syrup recipe sits under Instructions. Rachael said it looks great. Testers only: no public release, and not on Android yet.

howApprovalsWork: Greg or Rachael can approve features, website and marketing.
Store releases, spending and live database changes are Greg's.
Stefon keeps one queue and flags anything that overlaps.
